reason: I already have my gummies that I reorder when they run out, and I'm not looking to switch. A new brand I've never heard of with 'Made in China' on it is not what I'd pick over what I already trust.
objection: Is it really tested, or just marketing? A lab report on a page is nice, but I have no way to know it's real, and I don't know this brand at all.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the named lab's report for a real batch checked by someone I trust, or a friend I know telling me it actually helped them sleep, plus a cheap trial box for travel weeks.
